title: Fix timer double activity log recording (race condition)
description: Race condition menyebabkan activity log tercatat 2x saat timer selesai. Database dikonfirmasi punya 43 grup duplikat, 82 log berlebih sejak Oktober 2025. Root cause: Path A (useRecovery) dan Path B (useGlobalTimer) sama-sama trigger completeTimerSession dalam ~1 detik. Fix: (1) cleanup data lama, (2) UNIQUE constraint DB, (3) set timerState=IDLE synchronously di awal completeTimerFromDatabase, (4) handle error 23505 gracefully. Plan: docs/plans/2026-04-13-fix-timer-double-activity-log.md
close_reason: Fix double activity log race condition: DB UNIQUE constraint migration, immediate IDLE state reset in timerStore.ts, graceful 23505 error handling in sessionCompletion.ts.

title: weekly_goals reuse lintas quarter overwrite goal quarter lama (constraint/fetch/write abaikan quarter)
description:
BUG terkonfirmasi 15 Juni 2026 (ketemu saat integrasi AI-planner).

ROOT CAUSE: kolom 'quarter' diabaikan di 3 tempat:
1. Constraint: UNIQUE(user_id, year, week_number, goal_slot) — TANPA quarter
2. Fetch weekly goal (daily-sync/weekly-tasks/queries.ts): .eq('year').eq('week_number') — TANPA quarter
3. Write (weekly-sync/actions/weekly-goals/queries.ts insertWeeklyGoal): app reuse/update row (year,week_number,slot) yang sama lintas quarter, ganti kolom quarter + ganti weekly_goal_items.

week_number disimpan 1-13 per quarter (weekInQuarter, Q2 startWeek=14). Karena Q1 & Q2 sama-sama pakai range 1-13, (year,week_number,slot) bentrok lintas quarter. Constraint nolak INSERT baru; app 'lolos' karena UPDATE row lama.

DAMPAK (data loss nyata): saat user isi weekly goal Q2-week12, app reuse row Q1-2026-week12 (created 20 Mar) → quarter 1->2, weekly_goal_items Q1 DIHAPUS diganti item Q2. Goal Q1-week12 (slot1: 3 Layer/Unit Testing/E2E&Centralize Types — MAIN_QUEST DONE) LENYAP; task masih ada tapi yatim (n_wg_links=0). Tidak ada DB backup data, rekonstruksi penuh tak mungkin.

FIX (perlu terkoordinasi, TDD per CLAUDE.md):
1. Migration: ganti unique constraint jadi UNIQUE(user_id, year, quarter, week_number, goal_slot)
2. Semua query fetch weekly_goals: tambah .eq('quarter', quarter)
3. Write/insertWeeklyGoal: pastikan insert row baru per quarter (bukan reuse row quarter lain), atau key upsert include quarter
4. Data migration: backfill/perbaiki row historis yang quarter-nya ke-overwrite jika memungkinkan

ACCEPTANCE: goal di (Q1,w12) dan (Q2,w12) bisa coexist tanpa saling overwrite; fetch weekly goal hanya ambil quarter aktif; test cover skenario 2 quarter week-number sama.

title: perf: reduce vercel edge requests by fixing SWR revalidateOnFocus and polling in daily-sync
description: Vercel usage menunjukkan 889K/1M edge request limit dalam 30 hari. Route /execution/daily-sync adalah penyebab utama karena 6 SWR hooks meng-override global revalidateOnFocus: false dengan true, ditambah 2 hooks dengan refreshInterval: 30000 polling terus-menerus. Fix: disable revalidateOnFocus di semua hooks, hapus refreshInterval polling, naikkan dedupingInterval ke 5 menit. Data freshness tetap terjaga via event-driven mutate() setelah Pomodoro selesai.
close_reason: SWR polling fix deployed: disabled revalidateOnFocus across 6 hooks, removed refreshInterval from 2 hooks, increased dedupingInterval. Also disabled OS timer notifications in sw-custom.js and useBackgroundTimer.ts to eliminate logo-icon.svg edge request flood. All changes pushed to production.

title: feat(habit-tracker): implement Monthly Challenge Habit Tracker MVP
description:
Build a full Monthly Challenge Habit Tracker integrated into Better Planner. User currently tracks 18 habits in Google Spreadsheet and wants to migrate to the app for mobile access, automatic streak calculation, and integration with the productivity system.

## Scope (Phase 1 MVP)

### Data Layer
- Supabase migration: habits table + habit_completions table (existence model: row = completed, UNIQUE(habit_id, date))
- ENUMs: habit_frequency (daily/weekly/flexible), habit_category (spiritual/kesehatan/karir/other/...), habit_tracking_type (positive/negative)
- RLS policies for both tables (user_id isolation)
- Seed script: scripts/seed-habits.ts for 18 habits via service role key

### Server Actions (3-tier pattern)
- actions/habits/: getHabits, addHabit, updateHabit, archiveHabit
- actions/completions/: getCompletionsForMonth, toggleCompletion (INSERT or DELETE)
- logic.ts: calculateStreak (within-month), calculateMonthlyStats, buildCompletionSet

### SWR Hooks
- useHabits (CRUD + optimistic updates)
- useHabitCompletions (toggle with optimistic insert/remove)
- useMonthlyStats (useMemo, no fetch — pure computation)

### UI — Monthly Grid (/habits/monthly)
- HTML table with overflow-x-auto, sticky first col (habit name) + sticky last col (progress)
- 31 day cells per row: filled dot = completed, empty ring = not, dash = future
- Category separator rows (Spiritual, Kesehatan, Karir, other)
- HabitProgressBar: green ≥80%, amber 60-79%, red <60%
- MonthNavigator: prev/next month
- HabitStatsCard: overall %, best streak, habits count

### UI — Today's View (/habits/today)
- Habits grouped by time block: Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Before Sleep
- Large tap targets (min 44px), current streak per habit
- Header shows X/Y habits done today

### Habit CRUD
- HabitForm: name, category, frequency, monthly_goal, tracking_type, target_time
- HabitFormModal: add/edit modes
- Archive habit (soft delete via is_archived)

### Navigation
- habits/layout.tsx: tab nav (Monthly Grid | Today's Habits)
- AppSidebar.tsx: add Habit Tracker to trackingNav → /habits/monthly

## 18 Habits to Seed
Spiritual (9): Shalat Tahajud, Duha, Subuh/Dzuhur/Ashar/Maghrib/Isya On Time, Baca Qur'an, Shalat Tasbih
Kesehatan (3): Tidur Jam 10, Tidak Buka HP Bangun Tidur (negative), Exercise
Karir (3): Baca Buku/Kindle, Habit Tracker (meta), Weekly Review
Negative (3): Tidak Buka Twitter, Youtube, Instagram

## Out of Scope
- Daily Quest ↔ Habit auto-sync
- CSV import
- Cross-month streaks
- Advanced analytics
- Notifications

- Implementation Plan: docs/plans/habit_tracker/2026-03-28-habit-tracker-implementation-plan.md

title: Fix: Foreign key constraint error saat delete task yang punya timer_sessions

comments.author: abuabdirohman
comments.text:
## Problem
Saat user menghapus task (side quest, work quest, daily quest) yang sudah pernah dijalankan dengan timer, muncul error:
```
Error: update or delete on table "tasks" violates foreign key constraint "timer_sessions_task_id_fkey" on table "timer_sessions"
Code: 23503
Details: Key is still referenced from table "timer_sessions"
```

## Root Cause
Tabel `timer_sessions` memiliki foreign key `task_id` yang mereferensi `tasks.id`. Saat task dihapus, ada timer sessions yang masih mereferensi task tersebut, causing FK constraint violation.

## Solution
Sebelum delete task, hapus dulu semua timer_sessions yang terkait dengan task tersebut.

## Implementation
Update 5 delete functions berikut untuk menambahkan logic hapus timer_sessions dulu:

### 1. deleteSideQuest()
**File:** src/app/(admin)/quests/side-quests/actions/sideQuestActions.ts:108-133
```typescript
// Add before deleting task:
await supabase
  .from('timer_sessions')
  .delete()
  .eq('task_id', taskId)
  .eq('user_id', user.id);
```

### 2. deleteWorkQuest()
**File:** src/app/(admin)/quests/work-quests/actions/workQuestActions.ts:248-285

### 3. deleteWorkQuestProject()
**File:** src/app/(admin)/quests/work-quests/actions/workQuestActions.ts:456-493
Note: Ini perlu loop untuk delete timer_sessions dari semua subtasks dulu

### 4. deleteWorkQuestTask()
**File:** src/app/(admin)/quests/work-quests/actions/workQuestActions.ts:663-689

### 5. deleteDailyQuest()
**File:** src/app/(admin)/execution/daily-sync/DailyQuest/actions/dailyQuestActions.ts:75-95

## Pattern to Follow
```typescript
export async function deleteTask(taskId: string): Promise<void> {
  const supabase = await createClient();
  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();
  if (!user) throw new Error('User not authenticated');

  try {
    // 1. Delete timer sessions first
    const { error: timerError } = await supabase
      .from('timer_sessions')
      .delete()
      .eq('task_id', taskId)
      .eq('user_id', user.id);
    
    if (timerError) throw timerError;

    // 2. Then delete the task
    const { error: taskError } = await supabase
      .from('tasks')
      .delete()
      .eq('id', taskId)
      .eq('user_id', user.id);
    
    if (taskError) throw taskError;

    revalidatePath('/relevant-path');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Error deleting task:', error);
    throw error;
  }
}
```

## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Delete side quest yang punya timer sessions
- [ ] Delete work quest project yang punya timer sessions di subtasks
- [ ] Delete work quest task yang punya timer sessions
- [ ] Delete daily quest yang punya timer sessions
- [ ] Verify timer_sessions juga terhapus dari database
- [ ] Verify tasks yang tidak punya timer_sessions masih bisa dihapus normal

title: Fix: DailyQuestModal tidak filter by quarter aktif

comments.author: abuabdirohman
comments.text:
## Problem
DailyQuestModal di halaman daily-sync menampilkan tasks dari semua quarter, tidak terfilter by quarter aktif. User melaporkan task dari quarter sebelumnya masih muncul.

## Root Cause
Fungsi `useDailyQuestsForSelection()` di `src/app/(admin)/execution/daily-sync/DailyQuest/hooks/useDailyPlanManagement.ts:202-221` melakukan query tanpa filter quarter:

```typescript
const { data, error } = await supabase
  .from('tasks')
  .select('*')
  .eq('user_id', user.id)
  .eq('type', 'DAILY_QUEST')
  .order('created_at', { ascending: false });
```

## Solution
1. Update `useDailyQuestsForSelection()` untuk terima parameter `year` dan `quarter`
2. Import `getQuarterDates` dari '@/lib/quarterUtils'
3. Tambahkan quarter filtering:
   ```typescript
   const { startDate, endDate } = getQuarterDates(year, quarter);
   // Add to query:
   .gte('created_at', startDate.toISOString())
   .lte('created_at', endDate.toISOString())
   ```
4. Update SWR key: `dailySyncKeys.dailyQuests(year, quarter)`
5. Update caller di `useDailyPlanManagement()` line 290 untuk pass year & quarter

## Implementation Pattern
Ikuti pattern yang sama seperti:
- side-quests (src/app/(admin)/quests/side-quests/actions/sideQuestActions.ts:8-38)
- work-quests (src/app/(admin)/quests/work-quests/actions/workQuestActions.ts:16-44)
